verdict.rationale: Base44 ships an official CLI (npm install -g base44) with documented commands for authentication, project creation, eject/clone, sync, and deploy, well-suited to AI-native/agentic workflows (backend defined in code for AI agents to manage) and corroborated by a dedicated CLI docs section and probe hit. Missing for 10: independent hands-on third-party review of the CLI itself (community evidence covers the platform broadly but not CLI usage specifically).
